shots.focal_element: Low-angle, symmetrical wizard character seated cross-legged with a glowing orb hovering above the head
shots.typography: Persistent top-right logo bug: lowercase bold geometric sans wordmark with a short leading underscore dash; no other text
shots.what_happens: A 2-frame flash (0.083 s) of the wizard in extreme low-angle perspective; the contact-sheet frame shows a zig-zag lightning ring with starbursts around the figure while the mid-shot keyframe shows outlined plus-circles and dots instead, so the frame is mid-transition between decorative states. Lands during w20 'to'.
shots.build_rebuild: Render the symmetric low-angle wizard SVG on a flat dark background for 2 frames and swap the surrounding decoration layer (plus-circles vs lightning ring) on alternate frames to create a strobe-like flicker into the next shot.

shots.focal_element: Same low-angle wizard, now in full colour against a radiating zig-zag burst background
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug, here in dark ink on the light background
shots.what_happens: A 2-frame (0.083 s) colour-inverted flash: the background explodes into a light radiating lightning-burst pattern, the robe fills with a hot accent, plus-circle particles turn solid; it reads as a magic 'power-up' strobe on the beat before w21 'streamline'.
shots.build_rebuild: Duplicate the wizard composition with an alternate fill palette and a full-frame radial zig-zag burst SVG behind it, and cut to it for exactly 2 frames between two dark-background frames to create a flash-frame accent.

shots.focal_element: Wizard encircled by a crackling white lightning ring linking lilac starbursts, orb at the top
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: The wizard sits back on the dark background, hands raised, while a jagged lightning ring with starburst nodes boils around them; across the three sheet frames the ring's zig-zag path and starburst positions re-draw (boiling-line effect) and the hands shift pose. Covers the VO 'streamline your workflows.' (w21-w23); the code reports 2 motion events.
shots.build_rebuild: Place 5-6 lilac starburst SVGs on an ellipse around the character, connect them with a white zig-zag polyline whose vertices are re-randomised every 2-3 frames (stepped, on-twos), and gently rotate the ring while the hands alternate between two poses.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of the wizard's round face below a cream starburst, a funnel/cone forming between the hands
shots.transition_other: Detector-labelled non-standard cut from the wide low-angle wizard to a frontal face close-up; motion between the stills is not visible, likely a fast zoom or reframe
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: Face close-up: an outlined drop shape above the head fills into a cone with an accent-coloured rim as the hands come together and the character opens their mouth in delight (14.5 to 15.0 s). By the 15.5 s sheet frame the view has changed to a wide shot of the small caped character firing a long zig-zag beam full of cursor arrows and plus/x circles up and to the left, so the shot contains an undetected reframe or cut. VO 'So you can collect' (w24-w27).
shots.build_rebuild: Animate the face close-up with a mouth-shape swap and a cone that draws on from an outline then fills, then hard-switch to a wide layout where a multi-band zig-zag beam path is revealed from the cone outward with cursor and icon sprites travelling along it.

shots.focal_element: Small caped character at lower right blasting a diagonal lightning beam stuffed with cursor arrows toward the top-left
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: Wide frame of the beam shot: the cone in the character's hands spits a layered lilac/cream zig-zag stream carrying cursor arrows in several accent colours plus x-circles, growing larger as it recedes to the top-left; outline doodles (office chair, open folder, sparkles) float in the background. 4 frames long; probably a detector split of continuous beam motion rather than an edited cut. VO w27 'collect'.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a beam from 2-3 offset zig-zag polygons masked from the cone outward, spawn cursor-arrow and x-circle sprites along the path scaling up with distance, and scatter thin-stroke line-art props on the background.

shots.focal_element: Beam now swung to near-horizontal, streaming cursor arrows and icon circles leftward out of the cone
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: 2-frame continuation: the character's cape flares and the beam's angle sweeps from diagonal to almost horizontal, as if the character is aiming it like a hose; arrows now point up and right, suggesting the stream flowing back toward the cone (collecting). Likely a detector split of fast motion. VO w28 'more'.
shots.build_rebuild: Rotate the beam path's angle around the cone pivot over a few frames (stepped on twos) while re-drawing the zig-zag vertices and flaring the cape shape between keyposes.

shots.focal_element: Beam arcing over the frame into the cone as the character kicks one boot up
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: 4-frame continuation: the beam bends into an arch from the lower-left over to the cone, filled with large cursor arrows and plus-circles that read as incoming leads being funnelled in; the character leans back with one boot kicked up. Likely a detector split of continuous motion. VO w28-w29 'more leads,'.
shots.build_rebuild: Morph the beam path from a straight diagonal into an arch via vertex interpolation and pose-swap the character to a kick-back stance on the same beat.

shots.focal_element: Arched beam descending into the cone with oversized cursor arrows and x-circles at the top-left
shots.typography: Top-right lowercase bold sans 'zapier' logo bug only
shots.what_happens: 4-frame continuation: the beam now drops steeply from the top of frame into the cone, its cursor arrows pointing down-right toward the character, completing the 'collecting leads' gesture; the character holds the kick pose. Code places an audio impact at about 16.09 s inside this shot. VO w29 'leads,'.
shots.build_rebuild: Continue rotating the beam path so its far end climbs off the top edge, flip the arrow sprites to point along the flow toward the cone, and sync an impact hit to the final pose.
